import pandas as pd

# List of source CSV file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_30/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_30/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_30/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_30/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_30/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_30/training_5.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_30/training_6.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_30/training_7.csv"
]

# Columns of the target schema and their types
target_columns = ['created', 'screenname', 'followers', 'favourites', 'text']

# Read all source files into a list of DataFrames
dfs = []
for file_path in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    # Ensure columns are exactly as target schema
    # All source schemas are the same as target schema, so no renaming needed
    # Convert columns to correct types if needed

    # Convert 'created' to string (keep as is, but ensure no timezone info)
    # Some 'created' columns may have timezone info (e.g. Source7), convert to string without timezone
    if pd.api.types.is_datetime64_any_dtype(df['created']):
        df['created'] = df['created'].astype(str)
    else:
        # Try to parse datetime and convert back to string without timezone
        try:
            df['created'] = pd.to_datetime(df['created'], errors='coerce').dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
        except Exception:
            # If parsing fails, keep as is string
            df['created'] = df['created'].astype(str)

    # Ensure 'screenname' is string
    df['screenname'] = df['screenname'].astype(str)

    # Ensure 'followers' and 'favourites' are integers
    # Some might be floats, convert safely
    df['followers'] = pd.to_numeric(df['followers'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)
    df['favourites'] = pd.to_numeric(df['favourites'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

    # 'text' column is bytes represented as string starting with b'...', keep as string
    # If any are bytes, decode them; but from examples they are strings starting with b'...', so keep as is
    df['text'] = df['text'].astype(str)

    # Select only target columns in correct order (should be already)
    df = df[target_columns]

    dfs.append(df)

# UNION operation: concatenate all DataFrames vertically
target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Write the result to the target CSV file path
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_30/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
